settings.question: Will this help me pass NASM?
settings.answer: Yes. The SUF-CPT comes with all of our exam-prep material, free — the study guide that covers NASM, ACE, and ISSA, plus our NASM practice-question bundle — and a guarantee you’ll pass. Your SUF-CPT is its own credential; the prep just comes along with it. So if you want NASM or another textbook cert on your resume too, buying the SUF-CPT is the surest way to get there.

settings.question: Is Show Up Fitness affiliated with NASM?
settings.answer: No — no relationship at all. We publish study guides that help people pass textbook certifications like NASM, ACE, and ISSA, which is why some people assume a connection. The SUF-CPT is our own certification, built on a different philosophy: hands-on skill over multiple choice.

settings.question: How does the SUF-CPT compare to NASM, ACE, or ISSA?
settings.answer: Textbook certifications teach anatomy and exercise science but skip the business and sales skills that determine whether a trainer builds a real career. The SUF-CPT teaches both — and at $XXX with no renewal fees, it costs less over a 5-year career than most textbook certifications when you factor in renewals.

settings.question: Is the SUF-CPT accredited?
settings.answer: Not yet — Show Up Fitness has begun the NCCA accreditation process, which takes years and significant investment, and we’re seeing it through. Meanwhile, know this: no accreditation is legally required to work as a personal trainer — only liability insurance. What actually gets trainers hired is what they can do, and that’s why managers at Equinox and Life Time Fitness keep choosing SUF-CPTs. We’d rather earn trust with results while the paperwork catches up.

settings.question: How long does it take to complete?
settings.answer: Most students finish in about two months — comfortably inside your included 3-month library window. Study at your own pace.

settings.question: What if I need more than 3 months?
settings.answer: Your access window is 3 months. Most students who add a seminar go with the 6-month bundle for exactly this reason. Need longer? You can keep your SUF Library access going month-to-month right from your library — renew whenever you want more time with the live calls and new content.

settings.question: What if I cannot make the live calls?
settings.answer: Live calls are recorded and waiting in the SUF Library — watch on your laptop or in the app, on your schedule. Show up live when you can, catch the replays when you cannot.

settings.question: What is required to pass?
settings.answer: You will complete the coursework, then take your live exam in front of SUF coaches: name the 17 muscles of the shoulder and 20 muscles of the lower body, identify the 8 core movement patterns, and design a real program on the spot. If you can do that, you can train anyone.

settings.question: Do I need a weekend seminar to get certified?
settings.answer: No. Certification comes from completing the coursework and passing your live exam. The weekend seminar adds two days of hands-on practice at a Life Time Fitness — it’s the most popular add-on because touching real clients under real coaches builds confidence fast, but it’s optional.

settings.question: Do you offer payment plans?
settings.answer: Yes — you can pay over time with Affirm at checkout. A quick soft credit check (no impact to your score) shows the plans you qualify for.

settings.question: Where can I work with the SUF-CPT?
settings.answer: You can work at elite gyms such as Equinox and Life Time Fitness, other gyms around the country, or build your own book of clients and work on your own terms. All you legally need to train clients on your own is your skill set and liability insurance.

settings.question: Do I need insurance to train clients?
settings.answer: Yes — liability insurance is the one thing every working trainer needs, and it is the only legal requirement to train clients on your own. It is inexpensive, you can quote and buy online in minutes, and proof of coverage arrives the same day. Our partner Insure Fitness Group even has a dedicated Show Up Fitness page with a discounted rate for our graduates.

settings.question: I already have a NASM or ACE cert. Is this still for me?
settings.answer: Yes — and you have two good doors. Many students take the SUF-CPT to add the business and sales skills their first certification skipped. Others go straight to our Continuing Education track: Level 2 certifications and seminars built for trainers who are already certified.

settings.question: I passed my SUF-CPT. What is next?
settings.answer: Add more ways to earn. Our Continuing Education track has two Level 2 certifications — Soft Tissue Mobilization and Nutrition Coaching — plus weekend seminars. Each one adds a new service you can bill for, a fresh revenue stream on top of your training income, and each earns CEUs. Soft Tissue lets you charge more per session; Nutrition Coaching opens a second income stream many trainers run alongside their book.
